description: Exploit: the pre-registered BN-bias follow-up, which adds margin at no time cost. On the E061 tip (2/2/3 net, 2x20+3x24+3x28+2.5x32 px, head scale 2x, ls 0.4, BN-bias lr multiplier 16x; official 0.7560, dev 0.7586 @ 5.24 s), halve the BN-bias lr multiplier from 16x to 8x. Change nothing else: Muon lr and momentum, head lr, SGD-group wd and momentum, schedule, Lookahead, resolutions, freezing and the whitening-bias window all stay fixed. If the multiplier lives in the GPU schedule tensor, no recapture is needed; otherwise recapture all graphs in build. Log the absolute BN-bias:head lr ratio before and after (the references sit at about 1:10-1:13). Run the official seeds plus dev seeds 3-12 and compare against E061's dev mean of 0.7586. Contingency: if dev rises by 0.15 pp or more, try 4x next. If dev falls by 0.15 pp or more, 16x brackets the optimum and the BN-bias axis is closed.
